children.title: KCast
children.description: A Plasma 6 widget to cast video files or YouTube URLs to a Chromecast device.

repo_info.description: KCast is a KDE Plasma 6 widget that lets you cast video files or youtube URLs to a Chromecast devices in your local network. It supports device discovery, local media playback via an embedded HTTP server, and drag-and-drop integration with browsers and file managers like Dolphin.
